svg.title: White Black
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after an actually inspected identified primary photograph. Foundation1996 retrospective photograph explicitly labels White Black EK 246, at the far left. White rectangular painted ground retained; five black angular edge intrusions hand-traced from the actual colour photograph. Frame, wall and cast shadows omitted. Approximate flattened proportions. Christie’s same-title1961 record remains separate because its image/physical identity is unverified; no auction dimensions were imported. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-a-retrospective/. Foundation catalogue EK 246. Visually inspected 2026-10-28. Pure editable vector; no embedded photograph.
